notes.title: 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Extra Functionality[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Drag Multi Select:[/b] you can now either hold [i]LMB + RMB[/i] or [i]Shift + LMB[/i] to drag the mouse over any dice you want to quickly select.
[*][b]Auto Save Layouts:[/b] Layouts are saved automatically when exiting Add or Remove Mode. (Can be disabled in Settings)
[*][b]Move dice in Add Mode[/b] by clicking and dragging. Move Mode has been removed.
[*][b]Remove all dice[/b] in Remove Mode by clicking and holding on the trash icon
[*][b]Quick Switch[/b] between Add and Remove Mode.
[*][b]Remember Layouts:[/b] whichever layout you had selected last will be loaded first on launch
[*][b]All Dice Now Free: [/b] money is fake
[/list]
